I added the three features to `Shop.Cart` in `lib/shop/cart.ex`, with tests in `test/shop/cart_test.exs`. It compiles without warnings, Credo (the Elixir linter) reports no issues, and all 18 tests pass (14 tests and 4 doctests).

- **`remove_item/3`**: removes units of an item. If you remove as many units as the cart holds or more, the item is removed. A SKU not in the cart leaves the cart unchanged.
